messages.subject: CLE webinar: Developments in UK patent licensing - 5 Feb
messages.plaintextBody:
You are invited to a one-hour CPD webinar on recent developments in UK patent and technology licensing, including FRAND, exhaustion and post-Brexit SPC practice. Thursday 5 February, 12.30pm, online. Register via the L&D portal.

Knowledge & Learning
